on:

env:

  RUST_LATEST: "1.99"

  compute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      RUST_MSRV: ${{ env.RUST_MSRV }}
      RUST_LATEST: ${{ env.RUST_LATEST }}
      LIBPROJ_VERSION: ${{ env.LIBPROJ_VERSION }}
    steps:
      - name: Compute outputs
        run: |
          echo "RUST_MSRV=${{ env.RUST_MSRV }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "RUST_LATEST=${{ env.RUST_LATEST }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "LIBPROJ_VERSION=${{ env.LIBPROJ_VERSION }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # overall build status, otherwise the merge queue would need an entry
  # for each individual job produced by the job-matrix.
  #
  # Ref: https://github.com/rust-lang/crater/blob/9ab6f9697c901c4a44025cf0a39b73ad5b37d198/.github/workflows/bors.yml#L125-L149

  # ALL THE SUBSEQUENT JOBS NEED THEIR key ADDED TO THE `needs` SECTION OF THIS JOB!
  ci-success:
    name: ci result
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ success() }}
    needs:
      - proj-ubuntu
      - proj-sys-ubuntu
      - proj-macos
      - proj-sys-macos
      - proj-windows-msvc-bundled
      - proj-windows-msvc-vcpkg
      - proj-windows-msys2
      - proj-sys-ubuntu-asan
    steps:
      - name: Mark the job as a success
        run: exit 0

  ci-failure:
    name: ci result
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ failure() }}
    needs:
      - proj-ubuntu
      - proj-sys-ubuntu
      - proj-macos
      - proj-sys-macos
      - proj-windows-msvc-bundled
      - proj-windows-msvc-vcpkg
      - proj-windows-msys2
      - proj-sys-ubuntu-asan
    steps:
      - name: Mark the job as a failure
        run: exit 1

  proj-ubuntu:
    name: proj ubuntu
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: compute
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false

          - "--no-default-features"
          - '--features "network bundled_proj"'

          - '--features "bundled_proj geo-types"'

          cargo minimal-versions build ${{ matrix.features }} --direct
          cargo minimal-versions test ${{ matrix.features }} --direct

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
